aiOverview.content: The Outer Banks (OBX) in North Carolina are a 100+ mile stretch of barrier islands known for pristine, open beaches, quaint seaside villages, and rich maritime history, making them a premier, relaxing vacation destination. Offering a remote feel without large cities, visitors enjoy water sports, fishing, lighthouse tours, and scenic, undeveloped coastlines. This video provides a virtual tour of the Outer Banks, highlighting its unique geography and attractions:59sTripBeeYouTube• Jan 17, 2025 59s Key Aspects & Vacation Info: Best Things to Do: Visit the Wright Brothers National Memorial in Kill Devil Hills, explore Cape Hatteras Lighthouse, see wild horses in Corolla, and enjoy watersports in Roanoke. Where to Stay: Options range from vacation rental homes (popular for beach access) to charming B&Bs in Manteo and campgrounds on Cape Lookout. Known For: It is famously known for its role in early American history (Roanoke Colony), "Graveyard of the Atlantic" shipwrecks, and as the site of the first flight. Nearby Areas: Easily accessible by car from mainland NC, with popular towns including Corolla, Duck, Southern Shores, Kitty Hawk, Kill Devil Hills, Nags Head, and Hatteras Island. Note: The popular Netflix show "Outer Banks" is set here but primarily filmed in South Carolina.
